annotations.title: Technical signals and their historical returns

description: Returns the rule-based technical signals logged on the tracked companies, newest first: `limit` keeps the most recent, `window` gives the sessions they span, how many the log holds (`total`) and since when. With a scorecard of what each signal type returned when replayed over five years (after 1, 5 and 20 sessions, against SMH). Use it for recent technical signals or how a signal type has performed.

limit.description: Signals to return, the most recent (default 20, max 50).

symbol.description: Ticker. Omit for the whole universe.

name: get_signals
